panels.title: Decisions sent back to agents (live)
panels.description: Streaming query: a row appears the moment the policy decides. The agent's PreToolUse hook reads the same stream.

targets.sql: SELECT _tp_time AS time, session_id, action, reason FROM agent_actions SETTINGS seek_to='-15m'

panels.title: Tool calls (live)
panels.description: Every tool call from Claude Code, Codex, or the simulator, parsed from their OpenTelemetry log events.

targets.sql: SELECT _tp_time AS time, agent, session_id, tool_name, call_target, success FROM agent_events WHERE event = 'tool_result' SETTINGS seek_to='-15m'

panels.title: Alerts by detector
panels.description: Historical query over the last hour (refreshes every 5s).

targets.sql: SELECT detector, count() AS alerts FROM table(agent_alerts) WHERE _tp_time > now() - 1h GROUP BY detector ORDER BY detector

SELECT window_end AS time, count_if(agent = 'claude-code') AS claude_code, count_if(agent = 'codex') AS codex, count_if(agent = 'simulator') AS simulator FROM tumble(agent_events, 5s) WHERE event = 'tool_result' GROUP BY window_end SETTINGS seek_to='-15m'

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Historical query: spend and activity per session over the last hour.

targets.sql: SELECT session_id, any(agent) AS agent, count_if(event = 'tool_result') AS tool_calls, count_if(event = 'tool_result' AND NOT success) AS failed_calls, sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS total_tokens, round(sum(cost_usd), 3) AS total_cost_usd, max(_tp_time) AS last_seen FROM table(agent_events) WHERE _tp_time > now() - 1h GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 20
